input: Search the web for "youth enrichment" summer programs for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: KL Training Solutions
candidates.note: KL Impact Academy offers summer academic enrichment, physical activity and creative learning for grades K–8.

candidates.name: YTL Training Programs
candidates.note: 2026 summer learning camps for grades K–12 ran June–August, with STEM and agricultural enrichment.

candidates.name: Children First/Communities In Schools of Buncombe County
candidates.note: Elementary-age summer enrichment through its community learning centers.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer youth enrichment included science, clay art, dance, football, wrestling and teen activities.

candidates.name: Buncombe County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun day camps covered cooking, agriculture, world cultures and art.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: Summer Adventures serves rising K–9 with enrichment classes, hiking, water play and climbing.

candidates.name: Eliada Homes
candidates.note: Summer camp for rising first graders through age 12; ages 13–16 can serve as junior volunteers.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: Week-long outdoor Discovery Camps, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; 2027 dates forthcoming.

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 summer offerings included Adventure Camps and Kolo Bike Park Camps.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers youth overnight camps, elementary day camps, preschool programs and Music Week.

candidates.name: Playground Stage
candidates.note: Children’s theater summer camps in the Asheville and Buncombe County area.

candidates.name: Asheville Tennis Association
candidates.note: Free annual Terminettors summer tennis camp at Aston Park for underrepresented Buncombe County youth.
